api_changes: Domain.init(unicode: Domain) replaced by Domain.init<S: StringProtocol>(unicode: S) (converts U-labels to A-labels with IDNA.toASCII)
Added Domain.unicode() throws(Domain.Error) -> String (IDNA.toUnicode of name)
Removed Domain.isInternationalized and Domain.isASCII (always false / always true)
notes: No package under repos/ uses Domain(unicode:), isInternationalized or isASCII on Domain. The U-label form is returned as a String, a type that can hold it. README line and README Tests updated accordingly. Tests in Domain+IDNA Tests.swift use the RFC 5890 vector münchen.de <-> xn--mnchen-3ya.de.
